text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty HIGH - gpu-capacity-exhaustion (service=runtime-serving). Alert triggered: queued_requests > 2800 AND gpu_utilization reported < 5% by HPA for 6m (suspect metrics pipeline lag).
Dana Mueller: I'm oncall. Getting pages, customers reporting long tail latencies and 429/timeout spikes. Opening thread to triage.
Omar Reyes: joining. Quick check: queue length metrics show steady climb starting ~03:18Z. Prometheus shows scrape gaps for namespace `inference-gpu` between 03:20-03:30. prometheus remote_write backlog spiked.
Priya Singh: any deploys to monitoring or exporter this morning? deploy-bot: (automated) No deploys to monitoring since 02:40, but `gpu-exporter` was updated last night at 23:51 and `prometheus` retention bump happened earlier today.
Marcus Hale: infra: nodepool currently at 14 nodes, autoscaler state=active, but it hasn't requested more because HPA thinks utilization is low (metric pipeline stale). We should treat this as a metrics ingestion failure first.
Dana Mueller: Support Bot, notify affected customers with short note and ETA 30m.
Support Bot: (automated) Sent incident alert to: prod-ai, search-suite, partner-ops.
Omar Reyes: checking prometheus pod logs: `kubectl -n monitoring logs prometheus-main-0` -> `level=warn ts=2026-03-15T03:22:10Z msg="remote_write queue is busy: pending samples 1.2M"` then `level=error ts=... tsdb: write out of order sample` and OOMKilled on prometheus-main-0 at 03:24:45Z. Prometheus restarted and backlog replayed, causing delayed scrapes.
Priya Singh: prometheus-adapter logs show `timeout querying prometheus` and `no data points returned for query`. The adapter is healthy but not receiving metrics due to prometheus backlog.
Marcus Hale: because HPA reads custom.metrics which are stale, autoscaler didn't request capacity. Manual nodepool bump is possible but prefer restoring metrics so autoscale can act predictably.
Dana Mueller: mitigation plan: 1) force-prometheus restart to clear OOM cycle (Omar), 2) increase prometheus mem/temp storage to prevent replay thrash (Omar+Marcus), 3) temporarily set HPA to fallback resource metric (CPU) or set manual replica target, 4) if immediate capacity still needed, manual nodepool scale + drain policy.
Omar Reyes: restarting prometheus now: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart statefulset/prometheus-main` -> restart in progress. Also increasing persistentVolumeClaim size and restarting won't help instantly but I'll scale up prometheus memory limit: `kubectl -n monitoring patch statefulset prometheus-main -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"prometheus","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"3Gi"}}}]}}}}'`
Marcus Hale: initiating nodepool override +4 GPUs to buy time, ETA ~5m for new nodes. Cloud autoscaler override enabled.
Priya Singh: I'll prepare HPA fallback patch. Patch HPA to resource-based CPU target now to trigger scaling. Command: `kubectl -n serving patch hpa inference-gpu -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","targetAverageUtilization":50}}]}}'`
Dana Mueller: handoff note: Dana -> Omar if still active after 30m. Tag me when stable.
Omar Reyes: Prometheus pods came up but initial logs show backlog replay causing high CPU and longer GC pauses. Adapter still sometimes returns empty because query window is fragmented. Restarting prometheus-adapter to reestablish queries: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter`
Marcus Hale: nodes provisioned and GPUs ready. Queue length dropped from ~5600 -> ~2700 after nodes added and HPA patch. But we're still seeing client retries.
Priya Singh: HPA now scales based on CPU; replicas increased from 12 -> 20 within ~4m. That helped throughput while metrics pipeline recovers.
Omar Reyes: after prometheus stabilizes, custom metrics API now returning values but with ~60-90s lag. Found root cause: remote_write backlog due to retention increase + insufficient memory -> Prometheus OOM; replay increased load and prolonged scrape gaps.
Marcus Hale: important note: adapter mappings were fine; this was pipeline capacity. However, discovered later that exporter had switched label `namespace` to `instance_group` in one scrape relabel config change last week, causing some metrics to be scraped under a different label which made HPA queries fall into a different selector scope earlier when load was lower. Combined with Prometheus downtime, it delayed autoscaling.
Dana Mueller: so multi-factor: (1) Prometheus OOM/backlog = primary, (2) metric relabel change reduced HPA visibility = secondary.
Omar Reyes: mitigation summary: manual nodepool + HPA CPU fallback + prometheus restart + adapter restart + PVC & memory bump. Queue returned to ~200 within 18m of mitigation start.
Support Bot: (automated) Sent mitigation update to customers with status and next steps.
Priya Singh: follow-ups: - add alert when prometheus remote_write queue > 100k samples, - add OOM alert and node autoscaler buffer for GPU pool, - add rollout-time metric verification job that hits custom.metrics API post-deploy.
Marcus Hale: ops follow-ups: - increase prometheus headroom before retention increases, - add autoscaler fail-open policy to request nodes when queue > threshold even if HPA metrics stale, - add zone spreading for GPU nodes to avoid hitting zone quota.
Omar Reyes: engineering follow-ups: - revert problematic relabel change and add review guard rails, - add CI check to validate exporter relabel configs against HPA selectors, - create a metrics-canary dashboard and synthetic workload to verify end-to-end scaling.
Dana Mueller: oncall handover: handing to Omar for postmortem. I'll remain available. Make sure we tag affected customers for follow-up.
metrics-bot: (automated) Collected timeline logs and uploaded to incidents bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1956789012/logs.tar.gz
deploy-bot: (automated) Noted last exporter relabel PR #7123 merged by infra-team at 2026-03-14T22:10Z.
Dana Mueller: thanks team, incident considered mitigated. Preparing post-incident write-up: cause = prometheus OOM + relabel change reduced metric visibility; remediation = scaling prometheus resources, add alerts, add autoscaler buffer, add CI checks.
incident-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED (manual scaling + metrics pipeline restore). Postmortem required.
